title: SDGs Analysis Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The SDG Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the project's team and the operational, technical, and communications teams of UN-Habitat Brazil in Rio de Janeiro. He/She may also collaborate with municipal and state government officials, media, and civil society organizations.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Seven (7) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Program (UN-Habitat) is to promote the sustainable development of human settlements and policies that lead to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners to implement the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient, and connected places, with better opportunities, where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative and socially fairer urban economic, social and environmental policies. UN-Habitat initiated a project with the State Government of Rio de Janeiro (Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – GERJ) that aims to strengthen urban resilience in the State of Rio de Janeiro based on the implementation of the 2030 Agenda and the New Urban Agenda principles. The project Inclusive and Sustainable Rio helps the State to achieve urban prosperity while implementing global sustainable urban development agendas. In particular, the proposal focuses on increasing its urban resilience through the development of disaster prevention and mitigation actions. The "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit" is part of the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio initiative. Its primary byproduct is a report aiming at providing technical guidance, building local capacities, being a tool to strengthen connections, alliances and collaboration between local and state governments focused on the review of the implementation of the SDGs and the Agenda 2030 locally. To support the implementation of this project and UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, an SDGs Analysis Consultant is required to work on the "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit". Report to UN-Habitat Manager The SDGs Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The SDG Analysis Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Write a report concerning the a regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. b) Analyse the data and systematise it according to the characteristics of the regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. c) Visit selected regional territorial unit to validate the information and discuss priority projects. d) Prepare and organize participatory technical workshops. e) Provide, when possible, an integrated perspective on basic urban services such as housing, mobility, energy, water, sanitation, etc. and their vulnerability to extreme weather events. f) Support reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. g) Be responsible for maintaining an organized and accessible information file. h) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc. i) Be responsible for ensuring that all activities observe the principles of integrity of the United Nations. j) Participate in weekly virtual meetings—and occasionally in-person meetings—held during regular working hours throughout the product development phase, upon request. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The SDGs Analysis Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Situation Analysis Report Description: The situational analysis serves as a diagnostic of existing data and policies and their alignment with the SDGs, with the aim of establishing subnational coherence with the 2030 Agenda and identifying opportunities for action. The Situation Analysis Report must contain: (i) collection of information to identify indicators, policies and instruments related to the objectives of the VLR; (ii) alignment with the SDGs and other measurement tools for tracking progress towards the 2030 Agenda; (iii) availability and identification of data sources to assess data accessibility, quality, and availability, preferably disaggregated by population subgroups and geographic areas; (iv) prioritization and selection of indicators; (v) analysis of secondary data and policies, including, where possible, an assessment of their alignment with the VLR objectives, while highlighting successes, gaps and areas for potential improvement; and (vi) mapping of relevant stakeholders. The Situation Analysis Report will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) must contain: (i) in-person workshops for stakeholders to assess the Situation Analysis Report of the VLR; (ii) complete review and analysis of all collected data and its relation to the SDGs; (iii) strategic vision for the state government, considering the collected evidence to understand the current status of the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iv) recommendations to achieve the SDGs, establishing specific actions and paths to achieve the SDGs, filling the existing gaps identified. The output will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 120 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (final version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit (final version) must contain: (i) consolidation of deliverables (products 1 and 2), adjusting to the revisions requested by the UN-Habitat team and the Government of Rio de Janeiro; (ii) in-person workshops for stakeholders to present the preliminary content of the VLR and strengthen institutional capacities to implement the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iii) an executive summary synthesizing the overall performance of government policies within the SDGs, key findings, recommendations, and challenges to strengthen the localization of the policies. The output will consist of two separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction, an executive summary of up to five pages, and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. All volumes must follow the templates adopted by UN-Habitat. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Additional formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 180 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required.
• Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of professional experience in Urban and Regional Planning, working within or in close collaboration with public administration at the federal, state, and/or municipal levels, is required.
• Experience in work involving knowledge of and engagement with Brazil's National Urban and Environmental Policies, particularly their respective instruments, is required.
• Experience in work related to international, national, and subnational good practices on Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) is required.
• Experience in public policy analysis and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), with demonstrated expertise in intersectoral approaches, monitoring and evaluation, and the analysis and development of indicators and scenarios is required.
• Previous experience in social mobilization and participatory activities involving public officials, civil servants, and civil society is required.
• Professional or academic experience — such as research positions — in urban-environmental public policy and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is required.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Proficiency in technological tools such as Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), and referencing and formatting tools such as Bib Tex is required.
• Exceptional narrative report writing and editing skills, as well as proficient use of Brazilian Portuguese, are required.
• Knowledge and experience in qualitative and quantitative analysis of socioeconomic indicators are required.
• Knowledge and experience in handling databases from Population Censuses, administrative records, and other statistical surveys are required.
• Previous research experience aligned with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the New Urban Agenda is desirable.
• Knowledge and experience with the administrative divisions and territorial organization of the State of Rio de Janeiro are desirable.
• Good command of programming and data analysis in R software is desirable.
• Good handling of online event and conference tools is desirable.
• Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competency:
• Professionalism: experience working in inter-institutional environments; project management; monitoring and evaluation; and the development of approaches and strategies related to good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and Organization: professional approach to work and a strong sense of responsibility, with the ability to operate independently. Proven organizational skills and the capacity to manage workload efficiently and meet established deadlines.
• Communication: ability to write clearly and effectively; actively listen and interpret messages accurately; respond appropriately; demonstrate openness in sharing information and keep relevant stakeholders informed. Strong abstract reasoning skills and a proven ability to produce written materials tailored to diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: ability to work collaboratively within teams; demonstrate leadership, conflict resolution, and consensus-building skills; work effectively in multicultural and multi-ethnic environments while respecting diversity. Demonstrates sensitivity to the mainstreaming of vulnerability and a willingness and ability to operate in challenging contexts. Knowledge Management:
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 – BRL: Total net amount). UNOPS Salary Scale. title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams' time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver's license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Employment Type

Fixed Term - Full Time

Location

Brazil

Workplace type

Onsite

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sales Territory Manager - Minas Gerais

Gerente de Vendas - Minas Gerais

Job Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Territory Manager to expand our footprint in Minas Gerais market by prospecting and building relationships with large companies that have extensive PPE requirements. This role involves close collaboration with end customers to identify their safety needs, position our products as optimal solutions, and oversee the homologation of our PPE portfolio within these companies.

Once the products have been homologated, the final sales process will be facilitated through our channel partners (distributors). The ideal candidate should have a proven track record in sales, excellent skills in communication, relationship-building, and understanding customer requirements to drive growth while partnering with distributors to ensure market penetration and customer satisfaction.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Market Development & Lead Generation

  • Identify, research, and prospect new business opportunities with end customers (major companies with high PPE utilization).

  • Develop and implement a strategic approach to penetrate targeted accounts in the assigned territory

  • Customer Needs Assessment

  • Collaborate with key decision-makers at prospective companies to understand their safety and compliance requirements

  • Provide consultative support to educate customers on the beneftis and propor use of PPE solutions

  • Product Homologation Process

  • Present the company's products and ensure compliance with customer specifications and regulatory standards

  • Work closely with customer stakeholders (e.g. procurement, safety, and compliance teams) to sucessfully homologate products.

  • Sales Process & Partner Collaboration

  • Liase with channel partners (authorized distributors) to coordinate the sales process post-homologation

  • Ensure effective distributor support to meet customer needs and maintain excellent service levels.
  • Provide constant after-sales support to end customer to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations and keep our installed base.
  • Give technical trainning to end customers or distributors

  • Attend Trade Shows or specific Safety events withint the customer plant

  • Relationship Management & Customer Retention

  • Build long-term relatioship with end customers to ensure repeat business and foster loyalty to the company's PPW brand

  • Proactively address customer concerns to provide solutions and strengthen trust

6.Market Insights & Reporting

  • Stay updated on competitor activities, market trends, and emerging demands in the PPE industry
  • Prepare accurate sales forecasts, activity reports, and pipeline updates for the Regional Sales Manager
  • Use CRM (Salesforce) as a toll to plan the activities and the strategy for each new business opportunity, keeping all records

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor in Business, Sales, Marketing, Industrial Safety, or related field. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in business development, key account management, or sales roles, preferable with PPE , industrial products, and homologation processes is desired
  • Proven track recrod of successfully managing customer relationships in a B2B setting
  • Understanding of PPE industry, safety products, and homologation processes is desired
  • Familiarity with Brazilian safety standards and PPE related regulatory requirements is desired
  • Excelent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiatives in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong analytcal and problem solving skills with attention to detail
  • Proficiency in CRM tool - Salesforce and also Microsoft Office Suite
  • Fluency in Portuguese
  • Advanced English or Spanish is an asset
  • Ability to travel frequently withing the assigned territory (Minas Gerais)

Em portuguê s:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Território (Territory Manager) dinâmico(a) e orientado(a) a resultados para expandir nossa presença no mercado de Minas Gerais por meio da prospecção e construção de relacionamentos com grandes empresas que possuem elevadas necessidades de EPI (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual).

Esta posição envolve colaboração próxima com os clientes finais para identificar suas necessidades de segurança, posicionar nossos produtos como as soluções mais adequadas e conduzir o processo de homologação do nosso portfólio de EPIs nessas empresas.

Após a homologação dos produtos, o processo final de vendas será realizado por meio de nossos parceiros de canal (distribuidores). O(a) candidato(a) ideal deve possuir histórico comprovado em vendas, excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento, além da capacidade de compreender as necessidades dos clientes para impulsionar o crescimento do negócio, trabalhando em parceria com distribuidores para garantir penetração de mercado e satisfação do cliente.

Responsabilidades do Cargo:


1. Desenvolvimento de Mercado & Geração de Leads

  • Identificar, pesquisar e prospectar novas oportunidades de negócios junto a clientes finais (grandes empresas com alto consumo de EPI).
  • Desenvolver e implementar uma abordagem estratégica para penetrar em contas-alvo no território designado.

2. Levantamento de Necessidades do Cliente

  • Colaborar com os principais tomadores de decisão das empresas prospectadas para entender suas necessidades de segurança e conformidade.
  • Fornecer suporte consultivo, educando os clientes sobre os benefícios e o uso adequado das soluções de EPI.

3. Processo de Homologação de Produtos

  • Apresentar os produtos da empresa e garantir conformidade com as especificações dos clientes e normas regulatórias.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders do cliente (ex.: compras, segurança e compliance) para homologar os produtos com sucesso.

4. Processo de Vendas & Colaboração com Parceiros

  • Atuar como interface com os parceiros de canal (distribuidores autorizados) para coordenar o processo de vendas após a homologação.
  • Garantir suporte eficaz dos distribuidores para atender às necessidades dos clientes e manter altos níveis de serviço.
  • Fornecer suporte contínuo pós-venda ao cliente final, assegurando que as soluções atendam às expectativas e mantendo a base instalada.
  • Ministrar treinamentos técnicos para clientes finais ou distribuidores.
  • Participar de feiras, eventos de segurança ou eventos específicos dentro das plantas dos clientes.

5. Gestão de Relacionamento & Retenção de Clientes

  • Construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes finais para garantir recorrê ncia de negócios e fidelidade à marca de EPI da empresa.
  • Atuar de forma proativa na resolução de demandas dos clientes, fortalecendo a confiança.

6. Inteligê ncia de Mercado & Relatórios

  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre atividades da concorrê ncia, tendê ncias de mercado e novas demandas do setor de EPI.
  • Preparar previsões de vendas, relatórios de atividades e atualizações de pipeline para o Gerente Regional de Vendas.
  • Utilizar o CRM (Salesforce) como ferramenta para planejar atividades e estratégias para cada nova oportunidade de negócio, mantendo todos os registros atualizados.

Requisitos do Cargo:

  • Graduação em Administração, Vendas, Marketing, Segurança do Trabalho ou áreas correlatas. Experiê ncia profissional equivalente também será considerada.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiê ncia em desenvolvimento de negócios, gestão de contas-chave ou vendas; experiê ncia com EPI, produtos industriais e processos de homologação será um diferencial.

Responsável pelo relacionamento com instituições financeiras, negociação de operações de crédito, garantias e câmbio, bem como pelo controle de riscos financeiros e aderência às políticas internas.

Mantendo controle dos compromissos financeiros da empresa, confiabilidade e validação do processo de pagamento, dos lançamentos financeiros e contábeis;
  • Coordenar o fechamento de câmbio em diversas moedas, analisando documentação/sistema e intermediando, por meio da corretora, o pagamento dos compromissos. Assegurando o cumprimento dos compromissos perante os fornecedores no exterior;
  • Monitorar exposições a riscos de mercado (câmbio, juros, commodities) e propor estratégias de mitigação;
  • Manter controle da movimentação bancária diária, apurando saldos e lançamentos bancários, garantindo a validação do fluxo de caixa através do acompanhamento, análise e atualização do fluxo de caixa realizado e previsto;
  • Contatar fornecedores e instituições financeiras para solução de pendências relacionadas a pagamentos;
  • Assessorar a gerência quanto com relação as demandas da Diretoria;
  • Aplicar ou resgatar os recursos necessários a operação da empresa;
  • Executar o processo de pagamento dos financiamentos do BNDES;
  • Gerir o relacionamento com bancos e instituições financeiras, negociando limites, tarifas, linhas de crédito e serviços;
  • Coordenar operações de crédito, garantias bancárias, fianças, cartas de crédito e instrumentos similares;
  • Avaliar e propor novas estruturas financeiras, buscando melhores condições de custo e prazo;
  • Controlar o endividamento da companhia, acompanhando saldo, cronograma de amortização, juros e covenants;
  • Analisar e reportar indicadores de alavancagem, custo da dívida e exposição financeira;
  • Apoiar processos de captação, rolagem, renegociação ou liquidação de dívidas;
  • Auxiliar usuários do Microsiga (Protheus) no modulo financeiro quando solicitado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, ou afins;
  • Experiência em rotinas de tesouraria, conciliação bancária, contas a pagar e receber, gestão financeira, fluxo de caixa, pagamentos internacionais, Pagamentos FMM/BNDES, garantias bancárias (fiança) e aplicações financeiras;
  • Fluxo de caixa direto e indireto, investimentos financeiros, cotações de taxas financeiras, análise de investimento câmbio, produtos financeiros, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
This position is based on a Cruise Ship

Education and Experience Requirements

· Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.

· Hold a current valid medical license.

· Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.

· Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.

· Fluency in English.

· Strong interpersonal skills.

Reports to: Spa Manager

Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to on onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures, safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services, to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of on board guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi–Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi-Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain the knowledge of the spa services and products in effort to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi – Spa Sales Consultant. Position requirements Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests Work closely with the Medi–Spa Sales Consultant Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi-spa services Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality Excellent communication and listening skills Basic computer knowledge Must be a team player Duties and Responsibilities

· Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.

· Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld's medi-spa protocols.

· Conduct patient follow-up as required.

· Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.

· Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control

. · Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.

· Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager's office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years. (3 years on Cunard and P&O).

· Cross-promote other spa services.

· Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure. · Properly clean and restock medi-spa treatment room as required.

· Manage medical product and supply inventory.

· Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.

· Handle guests' questions and concerns professionally and courteously.

· Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.

· Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.

· Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.

· Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.

· Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.

· Train new spa staff in medi-spa services/cross-promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.

· Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies.

· Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report. General Guidelines

· For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.

· All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.

· At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy. · Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow-up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.

· Clean your room and set up for your next guest.

· Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest. This means the room must be:

· Clean – sanitize work surfaces and sink area; store trash is proper receptacles.

· (biohazard/sharps/trash); All trash must be taken out daily or when full.

· Organized –stock boxes should be out of sight and all supplies must be organized or stored properly

. · Inviting – the treatment bed must be properly dressed and proper ambience with regards to music and temperature. End of Day Checklist

· Dispose of open unused needles

· Dispose of Bio-Hazard bag if full

· Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full

· Sterilize table and countertops

· Fill out inventory control form

· Lock product storage cabinets

· Lock treatment room

· Email daily revenue report to shore side team Service booking policy A clean, non-intimidating, state-of-the-art and stress-free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. A critical element to the success of our spa is our ability to work together as a team. If we are unable to work seamlessly together, our guest will be the first to notice. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention:

· Medi-Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.

· In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services.

· Medi-Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager's approval. All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory. Please be guided by your Spa Manager's instructions. Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (known as 'GPS')

· Be familiar with OneSpaWorld's 'GPS' to safety. ·

Understand and practice the required self-screening procedures.

· Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.

· Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.

· Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.

· Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.

· Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time. · Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.

· Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.

· Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.

· Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.

· Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.

Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.

· Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.

· Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.

title: Comunicação | Executivo(a) de Contas Pleno - Institucional/Indústria Pesada (RJ)
description:
Who we are:


Burson is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

Burson is part of WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), the creative transformation company. For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Quem somos:

A Burson é líder global em comunicação estratégica, focada em construir e fortalecer a reputação de seus clientes para gerar valor. Com equipes altamente especializadas, tecnologias de ponta e mentes criativas e inovadoras, ajudamos marcas e empresas a transformar sua reputação em uma vantagem competitiva duradoura. Ao se juntar à Burson, você integrará uma comunidade global de profissionais em constante aprendizado, que prosperam na vanguarda da inovação.

Burson faz parte da WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), a empresa de transformação criativa. Para mais informações, visite e siga-nos no LinkedIn e Instagram.

Mais sobre a posição:

A Jeffrey procura um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas Pleno para impulsionar o desenvolvimento e a execução de estratégias de comunicação para clientes no setor Institucional/Indústria Pesada. O(A) profissional terá a oportunidade de participar de projetos desafiadores, contribuir para o crescimento da agência e desenvolver suas habilidades em um ambiente colaborativo e de constante aprendizado.

O que você fará:

  • Relacionamento com o cliente (interfaces diretas e consultoria estratégica);
  • Produção de conteúdo para a imprensa, incluindo notas, press releases e cases;
  • Manutenção de contato e relacionamento com a imprensa do setor de indústria pesada;
  • Apoio na produção e sugestões de pautas, além de follow-up ativo com jornalistas;
  • Apoio no desenvolvimento de planos estratégicos integrados de comunicação;
  • Monitoramento e identificação de oportunidades, online e offline, para dar visibilidade à marca;
  • Produção de relatórios periódicos com insights relevantes;
  • Organização e criação de conteúdo para eventos relacionados ao setor.

Experiência que contribui para o sucesso:

  • Formação completa em Relações Públicas e/ou Jornalismo;
  • Inglês avançado – necessário para reuniões, apresentações, produção de reports e planejamentos;
  • Experiência em clientes de grande porte de Indústria Pesada será um diferencial;
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro.

Benefícios:

  • Day Off no aniversário;
  • Um short day por mês;
  • Horário flexível e modelo híbrido de trabalho.

#LI-LS2

Você pertence a Burson:

Nossa visão é que a Burson seja a principal 'empresa acadêmica' para profissionais de comunicação criativa e líderes emergentes. Oferecemos um ambiente dinâmico e estimulante, onde talentos ambiciosos aprimoram suas habilidades, expandem suas redes e criam as melhores soluções para marcas líderes. Nosso compromisso com o seu desenvolvimento se reflete em programas robustos de benefícios e desenvolvimento de pessoas, incluindo oportunidades de crescimento profissional, mentoria com líderes do setor, uma cultura vibrante e inclusiva que fomenta a colaboração e a inovação, e pacotes de remuneração e benefícios competitivos para atrair e reter os melhores talentos. Investimos em nossos colaboradores porque acreditamos que o sucesso deles é fundamental para o nosso sucesso.

Na Burson, valorizamos o aprendizado contínuo. Entendemos que a excelência em criatividade e comunicação exige um profundo conhecimento e compreensão diferenciada. Por isso, buscamos ativamente talentos excepcionais de diversas origens e identidades. Essa diversidade é essencial para inspirar ideias ousadas, promover diálogos construtivos, criar experiências significativas e impulsionar a inovação para nossos clientes. Seu ponto de vista único – seu talento – é o que define uma #BursonPerson e nos permite, juntos, entregar resultados excepcionais.

Ao clicar em "Enviar inscrição", você compartilhará as informações fornecidas com a Burson. Recomendamos que você leia nossa Política de Privacidade de Recrutamento antes de prosseguir. Residentes da Califórnia devem consultar também o Aviso de Privacidade de Recrutamento da Califórnia. Esses documentos explicam como utilizamos seus dados pessoais durante o processo seletivo, como você pode atualizá-los ou solicitá-los sua exclusão.

You belong at Burson:


Our vision is for Burson to be the leading 'academy company' for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today's leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we're an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That's why it's imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can't do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it's how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our  California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Senior Telco Service Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting
description:
Job Description

Do you have a strong telecom engineering background and experience working with international customers? Do you want to be part of a global consulting organization while supporting a world-class telecom provider? Then this role is for you.

Tietoevry Create is looking for a Senior Telco Service Engineer to work on a strategic engagement with BICS, a global leader in international communications services. You will operate in a customer-facing, technically demanding role, ensuring high-quality service delivery across BICS' international telecom portfolio.

This position is based in Rio de Janeiro and operates in a global, multicultural environment, working closely with international customers and cross-functional teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Act as the main operational point of contact for selected international customers, ensuring seamless service delivery across BICS' telecom services.

  • Build and maintain long-term customer relationships through proactive engagement and customized operational interfaces, in close collaboration with technical and commercial teams.

  • Prepare and present monthly service performance reports and lead Service Review Meetings, driving continuous improvement through corrective actions and follow-up.

  • Serve as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) during incidents and escalations, coordinating resolution activities and delivering formal RFO/RCA documentation.

  • Advise customers on process improvements, reporting tools, and new services/products, supporting adoption of BICS' global offerings.

  • Collect and share customer feedback internally to support operational excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, including service processes, planned work procedures, and escalation matrices.

Who we are looking for

  • Solid experience in the telecom industry, combining strong technical expertise with customer-facing responsibilities.

  • Proven technical knowledge of message flows in Voice, Signalling, and Roaming scenarios.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and structured approach.

  • Customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage complex service issues and escalations.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are an advantage.

  • University degree in Telecommunications or equivalent professional experience.

  • Flexibility and accountability, including willingness to travel internationally when required.

  • Strong crisis and incident management capabilities.

As a person, you are reliable, structured, and comfortable working in a global, cross-functional environment. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and value operational discipline and continuous improvement.

We also value

  • Experience working with international enterprise or carrier customers.

  • Familiarity with SLA-driven service environments and operational reporting.

  • Ability to work closely with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

We offer

  • Professional growth within a global consulting organization.

  • Long-term, meaningful projects with leading international clients.

  • Open and collaborative culture with strong knowledge sharing.

  • Flexible hybrid work model and focus on work-life balance.

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment agencies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion )

Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Support the business by applying in-depth knowledge to offer solutions and advice through delivery of Group-wide performance improvement programs and/or Group Audit Program.

  • Governance: Delivers and deploys HSE training, audit and Group-wide performance improvement programs to the Divisions and Local Business Units.

Supports the sharing of best practice. Coordinates reporting on HSE performance and support delivery of Group audit program.

Your background:

  • +5 yrs relevant OHS/HSE practical experience, with preference within an international company

  • National/international certificate/diploma in HSE/OHS

  • Good communicator with ability to adjust communication to different levels of the organization

title: Equipment Inspector
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.


About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Maintenance Superintendent offshore.
  • Functional relationship with equipment inspection coordinator onshore.

    • Background


  • The Equipment Inspector will exhibit high level of knowledge in equipment inspection of boiler, pressure vessels, related systems and accessories. They manage common interfaces that arise in day-to-day operations with the FPSO departments' staff liaising with the Maintenance Superintendent onboard and with the Equipment Inspector Coordinator onshore.

    • Authority


  • The Equipment Inspector undertakes regulatory compliance inspections in pressure vessels systems and related instruments / equipments.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Visitors, subcontractors

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
  • 1 Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
  • 2 Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
  • 3 Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.
  • 2) Works
  • 1 Conduct internal and external equipment inspection as well as hydro test as required by the regulation.
  • 2 Ensure full compliance with SPIE regulation.
  • 3 Keep all inspection and equipments data book updated.
  • 4 Produce reports of the equipment inspection and its data book.
  • 5 Follow external audits and reports to the Maintenance Superintendent and to the Equipment Inspector Coordinator the status of the audit.
  • 6 Coordination of the subcontractors work on board the unit in regard to the SPIE equipments.
  • 3) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment
  • 1 Work area within own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.
  • 2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors.
  • 3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative.
  • 4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor.
  • 4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to Management System guidelines.
  • 2 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are segregated properly and dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Handover Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Plant and vessel knowledge Offshore - Global Enterprise Management System Offshore - Reports Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Planning Work Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment Offshore - Safety Management

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Experience as Equipment Inspector and qualified to Equipment Inspection Course.
  • Proven qualification on NDT and welding.
  • Experience and knowledge in offshore operation is desirable.
  • Computer literate on Management System 'Office' software packages.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of A2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

title: Head Of Event Services
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").

The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. Drive FIFA's leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.

  2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.

3.Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.

  1. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence and Project Delivery:

  • Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
  • Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.

Collaboration and Team Integration:

  • Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
  • Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
  • Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC's overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.

Stakeholder Engagement and Networking:

  • Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.

  • Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration

  • Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity

  • Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
  • Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
  • Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. Effectively manages pressure, supports team growth, and handles challenges with strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates the ability to assess the broader impact of organizational decisions and developments, anticipating their consequences.
  • Decisive Action and Risk Management: Recognizes situations that require swift, pragmatic decision-making. Takes initiative, explores various solutions, and is willing to take calculated risks. Acts promptly and decisively in response to unexpected challenges.
  • Planning and Resource Management: Skilled in developing detailed, chronological plans, setting priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Implements systems for tracking progress and control, and adapts plans as needed to achieve objectives. Maintains a strong focus on reporting and accountability.
  • Collaboration in a Multi-National Team: Leads and collaborates effectively in diverse, cross-cultural teams. Navigates cultural differences, fosters inclusivity, and ensures seamless communication across global teams, driving alignment and achieving shared goals.
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 5 years, ideally on an international level in the Event Services (Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations).
  • Extensive knowledge of event and sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro soon.

title: Analista de Atendimento Ativo
description:
A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país,  em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura: 


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

 Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. 

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.  

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos. 

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso. 

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega. 

O time de Logística:


A Logística é um ponto-chave na nossa missão de encantar o(a) cliente. Afinal, para atingir o objetivo de transformar o mercado de meios de pagamento, é preciso pensar em cada detalhe.

Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Para atingir esse objetivo, nossa área é responsável por atuar em toda cadeia logística (Supply, Sistemas, Last Mile, Gente e Segurança), colocando a mão na massa desde as compras das maquininhas até a sua efetiva entrega para nossos(as) clientes. 

Conheça um pouco mais do time de Logística no Nosso Manifesto.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Logística - Atendimento Ativo (Recuperação de Terminais) | HUNTER ANGEL:


Conhecido como Hunter Angels, esse time tem a missão de reduzir a quantidade de perdas de máquinas e aumentar a eficiência da cadeia logística, gerando rentabilidade para a companhia.

Para isso, a sua rotina é realizar atendimento ativo aos clientes por meio de telefone e, quando necessário, em múltiplos canais para recuperação dos terminais (maquininhas) que estão em clientes inativos.

 As principais atividades são:

  • Atuar no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Abrir ordens de serviço para que o time de Green Angels realize a coleta de maquininhas;
  • Realizar o cancelamento do cadastro dos clientes.

O que esperamos de você: 

  • Ensino superior cursando ou concluído (preferencialmente em administração, engenharias, logística ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ativo ao cliente;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Foco no cumprimento de metas;
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças;
  • Energia e protagonismo;
  • Disponibilidade de horário entre as 09h às 20h

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel.
  • Habilidade analítica. 
  • Já ter atuado com atingimento de metas.

Jornada de Trabalho: 

  • CLT: 40 horas semanais com 1h de intervalo diário | Escala: 5x2 (Segunda-feira a Sexta-feira)

Nossos Benefícios:


Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo 

Gympass 

Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Convênio SESC

Salário Fixo + PLR (quando preenchidos os requisitos)

Remuneração variável 

30% de adicional por periculosidade em cima do salário fixo, apenas em caso de uso de motocicleta (exclusivo para vagas externas) 

  Benefício Educação  - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e video aulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo).

Obs: Vaga de Estágio não contempla remuneração variável, auxilio creche, convênio SESC, PLR e adicional de periculosidade.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo


Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto. 

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Case Técnico (Em vagas de liderança) : Você apresentará a resolução de um case técnico simulando problemas que enfrentamos hoje na operação, tanto no assunto de pessoas quanto no de resultados.
Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone  


Aqui na Stone Co. valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente Caso queira saber mais:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Os principais desafios como PROFESSOR AUXILIAR I são:

DIVERSIDADE: A ESTÁCIO valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós, por isso pedimos para que não deixe de responder.

NA ESTÁCIO, REVELAMOS O QUE HÁ DE MAIS BRILHANTE EM CADA UM.

Somos uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições do setor educacional brasileiro. Há mais de 50 anos, proporcionamos acesso a um ensino de qualidade em larga escala. Estamos presentes em todo território nacional, ofertando cursos de graduação, pós-graduação e cursos livres, nas modalidades presencial e digital, e nossa busca constante pela qualidade acadêmica e investimentos na área de ensino garantem que as nossas instituições e cursos sejam reconhecidos pelo MEC com elevados conceitos de qualidade.

Sempre nos dedicamos a lapidar talentos para revelar a vocação de cada estudante. Os alunos também sabem que nós reconhecemos, em cada um, um diamante a ser polido. Juntos, formamos uma comunidade de diferentes perfis e sonhos, presente em todos os cantos do Brasil. Mais do que dar um diploma, a Estácio cria condições para que novas histórias de vida sejam escritas.

PROPÓSITO

Educar para transformar.

VISÃO

Oferecer a melhor experiência e aprendizagem a cada vez mais alunos, com eficiência, uso intensivo de tecnologias e valorização das pessoas, garantindo que nossos estudantes estejam preparados para os desafios do mercado.

VALORES

Foco no aluno

Todos nós trabalhamos para o aluno, temos paixão por educar.

Senso de dono

Agimos como donos, com orgulho de cada uma de nossas entregas.

Foco No Resultado

Cada esforço gera impacto real e sustentável.

Excelência Educacional

Superamos expectativas, entregando a melhor formação e experiência, em todos os segmentos que atuamos

Valorização Das Pessoas

Sentimos orgulho em trabalhar aqui. Desenvolvemos as pessoas e valorizamos entregas de excelência

Inovação e Tecnologia

Incorporamos tecnologia em todos os processos, potencializando alunos, professores e

colaboradores.

Diversidade e ética

Fazemos o certo, valorizamos as diferenças.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR POR AQUI?

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão, pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso.

Com uma forte apropriação da cultura digital, atuamos por meio do desenvolvimento de metodologias e de conteúdos que refletem os desafios e as necessidades do nosso tempo.

Temos um grupo de alta liderança extremamente sênior e competente, que nos guia com segurança sobre a estratégia da organização.

Estamos dedicados em contribuir para redução do problema estratégico de Diversidade & Inclusão no país, implementando um programa estruturado e colocando o tema constantemente em pauta com a alta liderança.

Somos vidrados no engajamento dos colaboradores e implementamos um programa estruturado de eNPS, com 5 squads rodando em paralelo com foco em melhoria contínua na experiência do colaborador. Em 3 meses de lançamento já implementamos 14 melhorias focadas em oportunidade de carreira e infra digital.

title: Gerente de Relacionamento PJ Pleno
description:
Sobre nós
Imagine mais de 9 milhões de pessoas construindo juntas um mundo com mais cooperação, pertencimento, responsabilidade social e justiça financeira: este é o Sicoob – Sistema de Cooperativas Financeiras do Brasil. Hoje, somos centenas de cooperativas financeiras com atuação em todos os estados brasileiros, sempre regidas por esses valores.

Quem faz parte do Sicoob conta com mais de 4,6 mil pontos de atendimento, milhares de caixas eletrônicos e uma diversidade de canais digitais que permitem o acesso a um portfólio completo de produtos e serviços financeiros – como conta corrente, investimentos, crédito, cartões, previdência, consórcio, seguros, cobrança e muito mais –, com taxas bem mais justas que as encontradas no mercado financeiro convencional.

Isso acontece porque, aqui, quem se associa não é apenas um cliente: é um cooperado e, como dono do empreendimento, participa democraticamente das decisões e dos resultados financeiros – resultados esses que são reinvestidos no desenvolvimento regional, em um círculo virtuoso de prosperidade socioeconômica.

Propósito
Conectar pessoas para promover justiça financeira e prosperidade.

Visão
Proporcionar a melhor experiência financeira aos nossos cooperados.

Cooperativismo e Sustentabilidade;

Ética e Integridade;

Excelência e Eficiência;

Liderança Inspiradora;

Inovação e Simplicidade

SomosFeitosdeValores <3

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

O Labs é a área de Inovação do Grupo Soma. Nossa missão é transformar o Grupo Soma em uma plataforma de tecnologia voltada para o varejo de moda. Somos responsáveis por criar soluções que agreguem valor ao negócio e por produtos que permitam escala e potencialização dentro do Grupo.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. title: Country Sales Director
description:
Company Background


Our client is a subsidiary of a large industrial group specializing in industrial supply chain technology and services, with an estimated market value of approximately USD 5 billion.

They support the industrial sector through an integrated supply chain + technology + services model and operate a B2B procurement platform for industrial products. The company serves more than 7,000 key account clients and over 8 million SMEs, supported by approximately 30,000 suppliers and a catalog of more than 40 million SKUs.

The company is actively expanding its international and overseas business, providing one-stop MRO procurement solutions across Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and South America.

Role Overview


The Country Sales Director is responsible for key account management, B2B sales strategy, MRO solution development, revenue growth, team leadership, and market analysis.

The role reports to the Country General Manager and directly manages 5–6 Key Account Sales Managers.

Requirements


Key Responsibilities


Key Account Management

  • Manage and develop long-term relationships with key account (KA) customers.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of customer business models, procurement needs, and growth strategies.
  • Conduct regular customer communication and site visits to identify changing needs and provide professional recommendations.

MRO Solution Development

  • Design and deliver customized MRO product and service solutions aligned with customer operational and procurement requirements.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to deliver end-to-end procurement solutions, including demand analysis, product selection, and after-sales support.

Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute B2B sales strategies and key account growth plans to achieve revenue and performance targets.
  • Identify new business opportunities through market research, customer insights, and industry analysis.
  • Drive market expansion and increase market share within the MRO and industrial supplies sector.

Team Leadership & Sales Management

  • Lead, train, and coach the key account sales team to improve performance and professional capabilities.
  • Establish efficient sales operations and customer service processes to improve team productivity and customer satisfaction.

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and industry developments.
  • Adjust customer strategies to strengthen the company's competitive positioning.
  • Contribute to the development and optimization of key account policies and commercial strategies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; industrial engineering or related fields preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, key account management, industrial sales, or MRO-related roles.
  • Proven experience managing large enterprise clients or strategic accounts.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, international business environment.
  • Proficiency in standard office software.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English; proficiency in Malay is a plus.

SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como

e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a
"Marca preferida dos Cariocas"
